title: When Reality Outpaces Cognition: A New Scaling Principle for Reliable Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.20764v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper challenges the understanding capabilities of existing AI paradigms and emerging world models by asking a fundamental question: How quickly can reality change before an intelligent system can no longer reliably perceive, reason, and act? We formulate this as a theory- and model-agnostic challenge in which systems must infer reliable actions for increasingly distant future states across a growing observation--reality gap. We operationalize this challenge through the effective Speed of Coherent Cognition (\(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\)), defined as the highest tested Speed of Reality (\(S_R\)) through which a system continuously satisfies a predefined behavioural reliability criterion from baseline. As a proof of concept, reinforcement-learning agents are trained at the baseline \(S_R\) and evaluated, without retraining, as \(S_R\) is increased by up to \(50\times\) while computational resources remain fixed. translated_title: 当现实超越认知：可靠智能的新缩放原则
translated_abstract: 本文通过提出一个根本性问题，挑战了现有AI范式和新兴世界模型的理解能力：现实可以以多快的速度变化，以至于智能系统无法再可靠地感知、推理和行动？我们将此表述为一个与理论和模型无关的挑战，即系统必须在不断扩大的观察—现实差距中，为越来越遥远的未来状态推断出可靠的行动。我们通过“有效连贯认知速度”（\(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\)）将这一挑战可操作化，其定义为：系统从基线出发，仍能持续满足预定行为可靠性标准的最高已测试“现实速度”（\(S_R\)）。作为概念验证，强化学习智能体在基线\(S_R\)下进行训练，随后在不重新训练、计算资源保持固定的条件下，在\(S_R\)提升至最高50倍的情况下进行评估。我们比较了Transformer和g……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的缩放原则——通过“有效连贯认知速度”量化智能系统在现实变化速度超出训练基线最高50倍时仍能可靠感知、推理和行动的能力极限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new scaling principle—the effective Speed of Coherent Cognition—to measure how far reality's rate of change can exceed an intelligent system's training baseline (up to 50×) while it still reliably perceives, reasons, and acts.
